description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot pipeline involving speech-to-text, language model, text-to-speech, and transport layers, with specific focus on function calling via CerebrasLLMService and integration with various speech and transport modules.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and execution settings.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration options for a pipeline task.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and control flow of the pipeline.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Maintains context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators for context management.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Defines a schema for a callable function.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Defines a set of tools/functions available to the LLM.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns for smart turn detection.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame for initiating LLM run in the pipeline.

classes.name: TTSSpeakFrame
classes.description: Frame for TTS speaking in the pipeline.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Fetches weather data via a function call callback.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the pipeline.
